business_problem: Before unifying its data strategy, Eurowings faced significant challenges with siloed data across disparate systems. Technical barriers in vector storage also slowed development, as the team had to manually manage storage units and make complex adjustments to hybrid search.
solution_summary: In search relevance achieved by replacing keyword-based search with semantic search powered by Databricks AI Search on eurowings.com Eurowings, a subsidiary of Lufthansa Group and a leader in the travel industry, aims to be the ultimate travel companion by providing seamless digital experiences for its customers. To achieve this, the company needed to overcome technical barriers that prevented users from finding relevant information quickly on its website. By implementing semantic search powered by Databricks AI Search and Model Serving, Eurowings achieved a 109% lift in search relevance. This transformation has reduced latency by over 60% and improved search recall from 50% to more than 75%.
